description: Gaming suite with an FPS overlay, game streaming, stutter analysis, and virtual gamepad tools.
notes: The official NSIS setup is downloaded and extracted by 7-Zip; Scoop does not execute the vendor installer or its installation routines. The archive's declared k-toolz.exe launch path passed the repository's Windows archive validator.

Although Scoop only extracts the payload, the application automatically registers the ktoolz:// and legacy lumora:// URL handlers under HKCU when it starts. This persistent Windows integration makes the application Nonportable under this bucket's classification rules.

The upstream installer checks for Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime and Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 x64 runtime and installs them when missing. This Scoop manifest deliberately does not run those prerequisite installers; install the missing runtimes separately if the app cannot start.

PawnIO (CPU sensor access) and ViGEmBus (virtual gamepad support) are optional drivers. K-Toolz can request their installation from its UI; Scoop does not install or remove either driver. They are separate products and may remain installed after the application is removed.

When PlainOSD, network statistics, or StutterHunter setup is explicitly enabled, K-Toolz can register elevated Task Scheduler tasks named K-Toolz-FPS, K-Toolz-Sensors, and K-Toolz-Analyze after a UAC confirmation. Scoop does not create these tasks; they may need to be removed manually in Task Scheduler after uninstall if they are no longer needed.

User settings, game library, and related data are stored outside Scoop under %APPDATA%\K-Toolz. The WebView2 profile is under %LOCALAPPDATA%\K-Toolz\WebView2. These folders are retained by scoop uninstall.

The pre_uninstall hook removes ktoolz://, lumora://, and the K-Toolz autostart value only when their command paths still point inside this Scoop app directory. Scoop also runs pre_uninstall before version upgrades; launch K-Toolz once after a Scoop upgrade so it can re-register its URL handlers and re-apply its saved autostart preference.
The application's own update mechanism is left enabled.
